title: Child marriage before 15, Landlocked developing countries (LLDCs), by location
headline: 31 of 32 LLDCs have data on marriage before 15; for 14, the latest is from 2020 or earlier
subtitle: Percentage of women (aged 20-24 years) married or in union before age 15
years: LLDCs: latest values 2010 to 2024; median year 2022.
data_line: Data: UNICEF via UN SDG Global Database, series SP_DYN_MRBF15, extracted 1 Nov 2026
alt: 31 of 32 LLDCs have data on marriage before 15; for 14, the latest is from 2020 or earlier. LLDCs: latest values 2010 to 2024; median year 2022. Countries in Landlocked developing countries (LLDCs) by year of their latest value on marriage before 15: 31 in all, 14 in 2020 or earlier.
method: Method: latest value per country; 2020 or earlier is not recent.
question: Which countries have found a way to measure marriage before 15 more often, and what made it possible?
